2023-08-18
Claim opened after a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. The claimant reports a concussion and is not
represented by counsel, so all contact is with the claimant directly.
2023-08-23
Verified that the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was in force at the time of loss. Nothing in the file
suggests the damage predates the policy start.
2023-09-26
Police report and two independent witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle and that the collision occurred
as described. The other driver's statement matches on sequence and point of impact.
2023-10-24
Reviewed scene photos alongside the repair estimate. Damage to the rear bumper, trunk, and tail lamp assembly
lines up well with the impact described. No prior damage to the vehicle is known.
2023-10-29
Medical records show a concussion diagnosis, and the reported symptoms fit the kind and force of the crash. Prior
records show a minor strain in the same region years ago that fully resolved.
2023-11-22
Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this injury. Requested updated treatment notes and a referral
summary from the treating provider to understand the course.
2023-12-15
Claimant later provided a few additional details about the event. These are minor, and the core account has stayed
the same through each telling.
2024-01-08
File reviewed and held for the treating provider's updated notes. No coverage issues identified. Next step is to
complete the injury evalutaion once the records are received.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
